snippet.title: Midgardr | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Midgardr is a medieval board game blending strategy and storytelling, where every choice shapes your fate. It's a solo, turn-based, city-builder, where you play through cards as a medieval administrator.

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645410/Midgardr/

🃏Card game & Board game
🧠 Strategy
📖 Narrative-driven
🏘️ City-Building
🔮 Choices & Consequences

You play as a duke, chosen by the King to govern a village at the edge of the realm. The fate of the settlement lies in your hands: build, protect and guide your people toward prosperity. But stay sharp: plagues, unrest and hidden claims lie in wait beneath the surface. Choose your Strategy wisely and forge alliances: only a clear mind and a steady hand can weather the trials ahead. Every decision may lead to glory… or plunge everything into ruin. Will your village flourish under your rule… or be swallowed by chaos?

Demo dropping in Q2/2026

Credits-
Music by Alessio Parea
